_comment: CXR dataset which has multiple bboxes

primary_csv._comment: The main metadata CSV that lists every image row.

patient_id._comment: How to obtain the patient ID. Provide column if it exists, or describe derivation.
patient_id.derivation: use image_id as patient id. 3 radilogists read the images, so the df needs to aggreagted: primary_df = (primary_df.drop(columns=['rad_id']).groupby('image_id').sum()>=2).astype(int).reset_index()

study_id._comment: How to obtain the study ID. Provide column if it exists, or describe derivation.

image_path._comment: How to obtain the image file path relative to base_image_dir.

labels._comment: Label columns and how to handle uncertain values.

separate_csv._comment: If labels are in a separate CSV, describe path and how to join.

uncertain_handling._comment: How to handle missing or uncertain label values.

view_position._comment: View position info (e.g. AP/PA/Lateral). Can come from CSV or DICOM headers.

reports._comment: Radiology report support. Describe format and location.

separate_csv._comment: CSV that maps studies to report file paths.

extra_init_params._comment: Any additional constructor parameters not covered above.
